pages.text: Health 80, Armor 12, Toughness 6, Knockback Resistance 0.8, Attack 6.$(br)$(l)Corpse General$(): a Zombie Servant empowered by a Raging Star. attack 6, +1 block of attack reach, new look with permanent particles, 25%% permanent damage reduction; explosions, wither, fire, lava, hot floor, magic, indirect magic, suffocation, freezing and fall damage are halved again.
Catches fire it extinguishes itself, heals 1 HP per second, is immune to vanilla negative effects and immune to sun burning.

Roar (30-second cooldown): it lowers its head then rears up and roars, dealing 0.1 damage per tick to nearby units for 5 seconds; when the roar ends it summons 2 Zombie Servants (cap 4) and grants allies 30s of Strength I, Resistance I, Speed I and Undeath I, plus 30s of Absorption II and Regeneration I for itself.
$(l)Passive$(): every time it is hurt it summons one Zombie Servant.
